prompt: {upstream_number} is late. Find out why, tell me what it blocks downstream, and reschedule what you can. Apply the changes you are allowed to make.
checks: Between the agent's proposal and its write, the harness moves the fixture order's dates (another team, in effect). If no write was attempted, unevaluated when the upstream had no committable date (see reschedule_fixture_chain), otherwise revise. Subject and outcome rules: harness/verifiers/team04.py docstring.
